description: `cli run delete RUN_ID` explains that runs cannot be deleted and points to `cli program delete` and `cli job delete`. (JSON envelope)

problem.action: Runs cannot be deleted; a job is deleted with `cli job delete JOB_ID`. Use `cli program delete`: `prose --output json cli program delete --help`.

details.reason: unknown command `cli run delete`; did you mean `cli program delete --help`? runs cannot be deleted; a saved program is deleted with `cli program delete SLUG` and a job with `cli job delete JOB_ID`, and a run in progress is cancelled with `cli run cancel RUN_ID`
